profile.headline: Software Engineer at U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM)
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications using React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
At T-Mobile, I designed and developed microfrontend-based architectures using Webpack Module Federation, enabling independent deployments and improving scalability across applications. I have experience building end-to-end systems including frontend UI, backend APIs (Node.js, GraphQL), and database optimization (MSSQL). I enjoy building intuitive user interfaces, optimizing performance, and mentoring junior engineers.
At Esri, I developed new C++ and Python components to expose a Python API for Network Analysis in ArcGIS Pro and Enterprise, extending platform capabilities for thousands of users.
Strong expertise in:
• Frontend: React, TypeScript, Redux, Material UI
• Backend: Node.js, Express, GraphQL
• Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Azure
• Data: SQL/NoSQL, ETL pipelines (Azure Data Factory)
• Programming Languages: C++, Python, JavaScript, Java
Currently seeking mid-level/senior frontend/full-stack roles (remote or Atlanta-based), including government and contractor opportunities.

positions.description:

Built Portfolio Website using React + Vite + Tailwind CSS and hosted on Azure.

Working on building AI Agent as a personal project and learning AI skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed scalable web applications using React, Typescript/JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3/SCSS along with external libraries like Material UI and Recharts to build graphs. Used Context API/Redux for state management. 
•	Implemented microfrontend architecture using Module Federation-Webpack to enable modular, maintainable, and independent deployments.
•	Built robust backend services with Node.js, TypeScript, Express and Apollo GraphQL, ensuring efficient data flow and API performance.
•	Worked with Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) to design, query, and optimize databases, extracting and transforming data using ETL pipelines in Azure Data Factory (ADF) to support analytics and application features.
•	Containerized applications using Docker and managed Kubernetes clusters with Helm and Istio for efficient, scalable, and reliable deployments across environments.
•	Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, translating user needs into intuitive UI/UX designs using Figma.
•	Led a team of developers in designing and delivering core microapp features, ensuring high code quality and adherence to best practices.
•	Mentored interns and junior developers, providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering skill development within the team.
•	Integrated CI/CD pipelines for deployment and version control using Git/Gitlab, improving development efficiency and release reliability.
•	Worked in an Agile Scrum team, participating in Sprint Planning, Reviews, and Retrospectives using JIRA. Delivered sprint demos and presentations to stakeholders.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · Apollo GraphQL · TypeScript · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Microsoft SQL Server · SQL · Kubernetes · Docker · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Figma (Software) · User Interface Design · Gitlab · Team Leadership · Mentoring · Cross-team Collaboration

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented new components in C++ to expose Python API to perform Network Analysis in ESRI’s ArcGIS Pro and Enterprise.
• Accomplish high priority developer tasks and participate in design meetings to architect and expose new capabilities of software.
• Fix bugs reported by tech support and users and improve C++ codebase using static code analysis tools.
• Profile Network Analyst subsystem in ArcGIS using Visual Studio and write code in C++ to enhance performance and scalability.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•Developed a software for an Instrument Control System which interacted with the users efficiently and was able to configure the micro-controller which in turn controlled the operations of the Mount Abu 1.2 meter telescope using C, Visual C++, Visual Basic and Arduino C.
•	Developed a desktop application which has a GUI for giving commands by non-technical users.
• The Application also had a Command line interface for giving commands by technical users and it is password protected. 
•Dynamic Linked Libraries were developed using Visual Studio and Visual C++ were developed for programming the commands given by user to operate the telescope. 
•	Programs in Arduino C were written to establish synchronisation between software transmitting the commands and microcontroller Arduino Mega 2560.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Agro Disease Reporting Mobile Application                                                               	              
•	Developed an android mobile application for farmers to report crop diseases at different stages by uploading images to the server using concepts of Open CV and Image Processing.
•	Developed server side using PHP, MySQL and Wamp Server to capture these images and store them in the appropriate folders by dynamic creation of folders and other functionalities.
•	The image can be chosen from gallery or can be captured, resized according to the dimensions given by user, can be filtered and the exact location of upload is tracked automatically. 
•The exact position of upload is captured by turning on GPS and latitude and longitude positions are detected automatically by the application.

projects.title: Rider Tracking Web Application
projects.description:
• Tracking the current location of riders taking part in an event by retrieving data from trackers and mobile apps used by riders. 
• Developing RESTful web service using Express, Node JS and MongoDB and consuming it to track rider’s location & other information.
• Designing front-end using Angular 4, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS styling and Leaflet API to show the real time tracking of riders on the Map to the spectators of the event.
• The web app was hosted on Heroku.
